messages:
ade: Heads-up: planning a short "microprobe" maintenance across APAC-edge cohort to exercise GPU microcontrollers and clear thermal hysteresis. Window: Thu 2026-04-15 23:00-00:30 UTC. Expect rolling soft drains with ~2 min host interruption per node.

nora: Which pools are targeted? Any impact to Dedicated?

ade: Targeting apac-edge-slice-C (burst & spot). Dedicated/reserved racks excluded; fallback to ap-south-1 regional pool if spillover.

fritz: Past probes bumped p99 for embeddings due to KV cold starts. Recommend pre-warm prefix/KV on standbys and enable short-term continuous-batching fallback.

samir: Agreed. Run kvseed 40m prior with seed=0.85 and concurrency=4. Also set autoscaler maxSurge=0.12 for the window (do NOT suspend autoscaler).

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created: MO-2731 https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2731

ade: Preflight snippet:
```bash
python infra/kvseed.py --pool apac-edge-slice-C --seed 0.85 --concurrency 4 --timeout 2400
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.12}}'
```

nora: Canary: 4 hosts in eu-central at T-30m. Abort if p99 latency delta > 0.5% or requeue rate > 0.8%.

fritz: Routing: latency-sensitive tenants -> ap-south-1, best-effort -> us-central. Netops will pre-adjust BGP pref at T-5m.

billing-bot: Quick ballpark: if 75k tokens shift to hosted at $0.0115/token ~= $862.5. Confirming in #finance.

samir: Timeline (tentative):
- 22:20 pre-seed KV on warm standbys
- 22:30 start eu-central canary (4 hosts)
- 22:55 validate + 10m buffer
- 23:05 begin APAC staggered cohorts (5min stagger groups)
- 00:20 final verification
- 00:30 window close
Who is oncall?

ade: Oncall: nora + samir. Fritz will lead rollout. I'll monitor thermal telemetry and kick rollback if thresholds hit.

nora: Rollback playbook (short):
```text
if p99_increase > 0.5% or requeue_rate > 0.8% or packet_drop > 0.2%:
  - pause rollout
  - re-inject drained nodes
  - route traffic to ap-south-1
  - escalate to infra oncall
```

fritz: Also mute synthetic evals and heavy quant jobs during window to avoid noisy signals. Set synthetic suppression tag at T-40m.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MO-2731 will start Thu 2026-04-15 23:00 UTC. Canary automation set for T-30m.

ade: I'll publish a short customer advisory targeted to burst pool owners at T-30m and lock autoscaler cap. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
